segments.contextAfter: World-tracking AR sessions use a technique called *visual-inertial odometry.* This process combines motion sensor data with computer vision analysis of camera imagery to track the device’s position and orientation in real-world space, also known as *pose*, which is expressed in the [`ARCamera`](arcamera.md) [`transform`](arcamera/transform.md) property.
